about.heading: About
about.bio_heading: I spent 10 years inside Berlin's cultural scene.
about.bio_1: As Technical Manager at the Berliner Festspiele, Gropius Bau and Volksbühne, I learned how these institutions work — what they need, what drives them, and what they can't afford.
about.bio_2: In 2022 I learned to code at Le Wagon Bootcamp in Berlin. Since then I've been building websites — focused on the world I know: culture, art, Berlin.
about.bio_ai: I use Claude daily at work — mostly for boilerplate, debugging and the boring parts. I still read every line before it goes live.
about.accessibility_text: This website was built to WCAG 2.1 AA standards — with keyboard navigation, sufficient contrast and semantic HTML.
